source.title: ProspectMate: conversion tracking addon, June 17 2026 release
source.author: urutseg

notes: New independent acquisition-path search, not a yield study. A June 17 2026 ProspectMate release claims prospecting/milling conversion tracking and local outcomes, but publishes no cohort-specific 2025/2026 TWW Bismuth, Ironclaw, Aqirite or Mycobloom completed casts, output IDs/rank, units, hits, zero/histograms, skill, spec, refunds, or replayable log. The author explicitly warns not to pool stats after changing profession attributes. Six name-scoped public export searches across GitHub, CurseForge, Reddit, US Blizzard forums and Wowhead returned no original raw cohort. Separate March 10 2026 r/woweconomy Aspalar post claims ~5,000 blue disenchants and average R1 0.42/R2 0.97 shards but lists 1.45 combined (numerically inconsistent), no exact output/item IDs or expansion; not eligible for The War Within study estimates, and no total-unit/hit evidence. No previous 2024 Reikah/PeaEsk/DobberSH/LotzBoi cohort was re-recorded. All missing numbers remain null; no numerical baseline advanced.
